concerns.text: The plan acknowledges a verified VIF of 33 (far above the SC‑005 threshold of VIF < 5) yet claims the success criterion is still satisfied because the metric is measured. This is contradictory: high multicollinearity invalidates the interpretability of the entropy coefficient and directly violates SC‑005, making the claimed validity of the analysis unsound.

The specification (FR‑004) requires a mixed‑effects model with a subject random intercept, but the plan implements a simple OLS per parcel, stating a random intercept is unnecessary. Ignoring the required random effect may bias standard errors and inflate false‑positive rates, undermining the scientific validity of the reported associations.
